about: Every game system the mashup touches. One row per system: which game owns it, what the player gets, the hooks (hooks.json ids) and data tables (gameplay.json tables) it uses, the module that builds it, and how it is verified. verified is filled in only after a test in the running games.

rows.player_gets: both games start together and talk through shared memory (Rust link)
rows.verify_by: log: layout self-check PASS, ring self-test PASS, link up
rows.verified: 2026-10-09: layout PASS (21 structs, 150 fields, C#+Rust), ring self-test PASS, link up with Minecraft 26.3 (pid 26892), relinks after RoR2 restarts
